strategy.name: qqq_stochrsi_sparse_entry_factorial
strategy.description: Eight zero-cost long-only QQQ cases form the full 2x2x2 factorial of three buy switches on top of the frozen TIM-v0.80 sell state machine. Switch D replaces immediate B1/B2 fills with the same virtual tranche accounting and releases the accumulated notional on a strict raw StochRSI100 upcross from <=0.20 to >0.20. Switch F arms after a strict StochRSI42 downcross below 0.20 and, on the next strict recovery upcross above 0.20, buys 40% of remaining cash only when pre-trade QQQ weight is below 15% and StochRSI100 is above 0.20. Switch S buys 50% of remaining cash when pre-trade QQQ weight is below 15% and StochRSI100 strictly upcrosses 0.20. On a shared Close, a deferred-queue release executes first; S then supersedes F and sizes from the remaining cash. Sparse buys do not change a, buy_b, the B2 counter, or a pending queue. Any actual sale resets the F arm along with the existing buy-cycle state.
strategy.buy_rule: For every combination D/F/S in {off,on}^3: D off preserves immediate B2-over-B1 buys; D on queues the identical virtual B1/B2 dollar tranches and releases them on prior StochRSI100 <=0.20 and current >0.20. F on records a strict StochRSI42 downcross prior>=0.20/current<0.20; its next strict upcross prior<=0.20/current>0.20 buys 40% of remaining cash if pre-trade QQQ weight<15% and current StochRSI100>0.20, then clears the arm whether or not the weight/filter allowed a buy. S on buys 50% of remaining cash if pre-trade QQQ weight<15% on a strict StochRSI100 upcross prior<=0.20/current>0.20. Priority on the same Close is deferred release, then S; F is suppressed when S triggers. All conditions use strict crossings and completed Close data.
strategy.sell_rule: All eight cases preserve TIM-v0.80's Pool A and Pool B sell mechanisms, including Pool A priority, daily decay in the 0.50-0.80 zone, armed downcross below 0.50, crowded-position Pool B accumulation and downcross below 0.70, and the strict theoretical-price fast-drop special case. Ordinary sale days block same-Close buys; the existing fast-drop special case may permit a buy after selling.
strategy.signal_time: Raw StochRSI42/100 levels, sparse-weight tests, arm state, and strict crossings are confirmed using the completed current adjusted Close. Pre-trade QQQ weight is measured before every same-Close order as QQQ market value divided by total account equity.
strategy.execution_time: Ordinary buys and sells fill at the same adjusted Close that confirms the signal. When multiple buys share a Close, the deferred queue fills first and the 50% StochRSI100 recovery buy sizes from the remaining cash; the 40% StochRSI42 recovery buy is suppressed. The unchanged fast-drop sale uses its theoretical StochRSI100=0.30 price without an OHLC-touch gate.
strategy.positioning: Long-only fractional QQQ and cash from $100,000 initial capital. The original B1/B2 minimum shortfalls remain explicit external contributions and are mirrored into each case's own modified Buy & Hold. Sparse 40%/50% buys use remaining cash only and never introduce external capital. Pending deferred tranches remain reserved and any actual sale cancels them.

plain_language.summary: 用八个组合检验低位金额延迟买入和两种低仓位恢复买入能否改善QQQ的持仓路径。
plain_language.buy: 原有低位补仓可以立即执行或累计到长周期指标上穿0.2再执行；仓位很低时，还可分别启用短周期恢复买入和长周期恢复买入。
plain_language.sell: 八个版本都沿用原策略的两个虚拟池减仓规则，不改变卖出逻辑。
plain_language.execution: 当天收盘确认并成交；同日先执行累计金额，随后长周期50%买入优先于短周期40%买入。
plain_language.position: 账户只持有QQQ和现金，新增恢复买入只使用剩余现金，原规则所需追加本金仍同步投入对应的Modified Buy & Hold。

factorial_switches.D: queue B1/B2 and release on strict StochRSI100 upcross above 0.20
factorial_switches.F: when pre-trade weight<15%, buy 40% cash on armed StochRSI42 recovery above 0.20 while StochRSI100>0.20
factorial_switches.S: when pre-trade weight<15%, buy 50% cash on strict StochRSI100 upcross above 0.20

parameters.performance_return_method_with_flows: daily time weighted returns; XIRR also reported

financing: No leverage or borrowing. Only frozen B1/B2 minimum shortfalls can add external cash; sparse recovery buys cannot.
benchmark: Each of the eight cases is compared with its own contribution-matched QQQ Buy & Hold. Naive Buy & Hold invests only the initial $100,000 at the first analysis Close.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 unchanged and reuse the accepted StochRSI market, virtual-pool, QQQ-position-value, cash, factorial-performance, and drawdown figure patterns.

research.hypothesis: Low-position recovery entries may repair the return drag of deferred B1/B2 accumulation, and the 2x2x2 factorial can identify whether their effects are additive or interaction-dependent.
research.primary_metric: CAGR gap and maximum-drawdown improvement versus each case's contribution-matched Buy & Hold, interpreted with Sharpe, XIRR, external contributions, turnover, average QQQ weight, order attribution, and factorial main/interaction effects
research.selection_rule: Evaluate all eight predeclared cases. Report all cells and exact factorial contrasts; prefer a Pareto set and do not select a winner unless Sharpe is at least matched Buy & Hold, drawdown improves by at least 8 percentage points, and CAGR gap is no worse than -2 percentage points.
research.validation_plan: Reconcile every case's orders, contributions, daily state and FIFO trades against compiled PyBroker replay; verify strict crossings, F arming, pre-trade weight, same-day priority and zero leftover pending notional; treat the entire interval as exploratory.
research.promotion_criteria: A fixed combination passes all engineering gates and materially improves the return/drawdown/capital-demand tradeoff without depending on the OHLC-unchecked fast-drop fill.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject a case or rule if reconciliation fails, a sparse buy occurs without its strict crossing and weight filter, same-day priority double-spends cash, pending notional is lost, or the apparent benefit is dominated by external contributions or an idealized untriggered event.
